canonical_artifact_registry.identity_policy: Artifact IDs and provenance remain defined by the canonical artifact registry; this recovery index references that registry rather than copying or renumbering its entries.

repository.source_commit_role: Base revision used to assemble this index, before the index files were added. index_introduced_by_commit records the merge commit that introduced the index.

verification.method: recursive source and destination listing comparison

dropbox_snapshots.independence: same Dropbox account as source; not an offline or independently administered backup

restoration_history.description: Automated test restored a committed file from its recorded Git revision into a snapshot-specific recovery directory and confirmed a second restore refuses to overwrite.

pending_controls: Generate a fresh SHA-256 snapshot manifest from a clean checkout and store a copy outside the GitHub repository.

Perform and record a real Dropbox restore drill into a separate destination.
Establish an independently administered or offline backup location.
Enable GitHub main-branch rules requiring pull requests and the protection-gates status check; prevent force pushes and branch deletion.

update_policy.note: This index is a coordination record. Git commit history and Dropbox revisions remain the underlying recovery sources.
